reason: The acquisition of Bliss GVS Pharma accelerates the company's strategy to build an integrated global pharmaceutical platform, potentially improving margins through vertical integration.

source_headlines: Anupam Rasayan India Limited: Anupam Rasayan India Limited has informed the Exchange regarding a press release titled "Anupam Rasayan Concludes Acquisition of Bliss GVS Pharma, Marks Third Strategic Step Towards Building an Integrated Global Pharma Platform".
